generate_concentric_circles_dataset: generate a dataset of two concentric circles with 200 samples using make_circles
train_LabelSpreading_model: train a LabelSpreading model with KNN kernel and alpha 0.8 on labeled and unlabeled data
predict_labels_with_transduction: predict labels for unlabeled samples using LabelSpreading transduction_ attribute
plot_raw_data_scatter: plot raw concentric circle data with labeled and unlabeled samples using matplotlib scatter
plot_learned_labels_scatter: plot predicted labels from LabelSpreading model using matplotlib scatter
